title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits (Nov. 17, 2026)
summary: The Philippines is hosting the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits. Here are the latest news and developments on Day 3, November 17, 2026.

blocks.text: 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits at the PICC
Trump departs for Philippines to attend ASEAN summit

US President Donald Trump departed Washington on Monday (November 16) for a trip to Asia that includes an ASEAN summit in the Philippines and a visit to China, where he said he might meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also joined Trump on the trip, boarding Air Force One with him at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland. —Reuters
Marcos emphasizes kapwa and interconnectivity at ASEAN Dinner
President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and First Lady Louise Araneta-Marcos hosted leaders of ASEAN member-nations and external partners around a Filipino table on Monday evening.

"The strength of ASEAN goes beyond agendas and agreements. It is sustained by relationships, mutual trust, and the recognition that the peace, prosperity, and well-being of its Member States are interconnected," the Presidential Communications Office said. — BAP, GMA News
